open_points.subject: bootstrap_first_administrator
open_points.text: build the account with the imported build_bootstrap_staff_account from the normalized email, that hash and the one utc_now instant, build its audit record with the imported build_bootstrap_audit_record from that same instant and the built account, and hand both to the port in one call.
open_points.other_text: MUST return the hash-free = models.StaffAccountView the imported build_staff_account_view builds from the account it handed to the port, so the password hash never leaves this module.
open_points.question: Must the account containing the password hash be handed to the port, or must the claim that the password hash never leaves this module be narrowed to say that it is not included in the returned StaffAccountView?
